headline: HECLA Q2: LUCKY FRIDAY HITS RECORD SILVER QUARTER — $199M EBITDA, $136M FCF Both Double Year-Over-Year
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Hecla Mining Company
snippet: Hecla Mining Company (NYSE: HL) — America's largest silver producer — reported Q2 2026 results on August 4 with revenue of $334 million, adjusted EBITDA of $199 million (more than double Q2 2025's $93 million), and free cash flow of $136 million (also more than doubled year-over-year), as the Lucky Friday Mine in Idaho delivered its all-time record quarterly silver production. The company reiterated full-year 2026 silver guidance of 15.1–16.5 million ounces and confirmed a long-term path to over 20 million ounces annually — meaning that at $58–60 silver and $199 million of quarterly EBITDA, Hecla is now generating cash at a rate that historically accelerates consolidation activity in the junior silver exploration space it anchors.

headline: QATAR TABLES HORMUZ INTERIM DEAL — Gold Holds $4,095 As Sep Hike Odds Trim To 57%; Oil Down 3rd Day Ahead of Friday NFP
snippet: Qatar tabled an interim Strait of Hormuz reopening proposal on Tuesday with both Washington and Tehran signaling progress, triggering a third consecutive day of oil price declines and pulling September Federal Reserve rate-hike expectations down from 67% to 57%. Gold firmed to $4,095 on Wednesday morning — up 0.44% — as the de-escalation scenario reduces the oil-inflation-rate-hike chain that has capped the metal below $4,100 since June; however, Friday's July Non-Farm Payrolls remains the binary catalyst that either kills the September hike narrative (a print below 100,000 jobs like June's 57,000 surprise) or validates it (above 150,000), determining whether junior gold and silver equities get their macro tailwind before Q4 or must wait longer.

headline: RUA GOLD GREEN-LIT IN NZ'S HAURAKI — 9,000m Program Next To OceanaGold's 1.5Moz @ 17.3 g/t (TSX: RUA)
snippet: Rua Gold Inc. (TSX: RUA) received regulatory approval on August 4 to commence exploration drilling at the Glamorgan Project in New Zealand's Hauraki Goldfield — one of the world's highest-grade historic gold provinces, where more than 50 mines produced a combined 15 million ounces. The fully funded initial program of approximately 9,000 metres across multiple targets is set to commence in Q4 2026 and sits immediately adjacent to OceanaGold's Wharekirauponga deposit, which hosts Indicated Mineral Resources of 1.5 million ounces at 17.3 g/t Au — establishing the grade template for what a discovery in this geological address is worth to a senior gold producer generating record margins above $4,000 gold.

headline: CRITICAL ELEMENTS RESUMES LITHIUM DRILLING — Rose West Pegmatite Extended To 1,250m x 800m After Forest Fire (CRE)
source_name: Investing News Network / Critical Elements Lithium Corp.
snippet: Critical Elements Lithium Corporation (TSX-V: CRE) resumed its 10,000-metre Phase 2 Summer 2026 drill program at the Rose West Discovery in Eeyou Istchee, Québec on August 4 following a precautionary suspension caused by a forest fire near the project camp. Eleven holes completed before the pause (2,073 metres) already confirmed that recent drilling extends the near-surface, sub-horizontal spodumene-rich pegmatite's overall footprint to approximately 1,250 metres by 800 metres — a meaningful expansion of the discovery within 10 km of the fully permitted, 100%-owned Rose Lithium-Tantalum Project — as the company advances what could become an important satellite resource in a lithium-hungry but supply-constrained hard-rock market.

headline: COLLECTIVE MINING LIFTS TO NASDAQ GLOBAL SELECT — 14 Rigs At Apollo Colombia, $129.6M Cash As US Tier Upgrades (CNL)
source_name: Investing News Network / Collective Mining Ltd.
snippet: Collective Mining Ltd. (TSX: CNL) announced it will voluntarily transfer its U.S. stock exchange listing from the NYSE American to the Nasdaq Global Select Market — the highest tier of the Nasdaq — effective August 11, 2026, while its TSX listing remains unchanged. The transfer comes as the company advances its flagship Apollo gold-silver-copper-tungsten system in Caldas, Colombia with up to 14 rigs in 2026 and US$129.6 million in year-end 2025 cash; with 177,000 metres drilled and the high-grade Apollo breccia circumference expanding, a Nasdaq Global Select listing signals management's confidence in approaching a major resource milestone that warrants expanded institutional eligibility and index inclusion.

headline: ENERGY FUELS $104M RARE EARTH PLANT STARTS — 120 tpa Dysprosium In Utah; First US Commercial Heavy REE In Decades (UUUU)
snippet: Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE American: UUUU) broke ground on a $104 million expansion of its White Mesa Mill in Utah on August 4 to produce commercial-scale quantities of heavy rare earth oxides — targeting 120 tonnes per annum of dysprosium, 20 tpa of terbium, 140 tpa of samarium, 20 tpa of europium, and 140 tpa of gadolinium oxide — with dysprosium and terbium circuits targeted for completion by end-2027, largely funded by US government grants. The construction start marks the first attempt to build commercial-scale domestic heavy rare earth separation in the United States in decades, directly addressing the supply chain vulnerability exposed by China's suspension of heavy rare earth exports — including to Japan — and provides a critical magnet supply chain from US-sourced ore to finished heavy REE oxides for EV, defense, and industrial applications.

headline: MINERALS 260: 20m @ 3.4 g/t Au At Bullabulling — Mineralisation To 332m Depth; August MRE Update Imminent (ASX: MI6)
snippet: Minerals 260 Limited (ASX: MI6) released new drilling results from its 100%-owned Bullabulling Gold Project — 25 km west of Coolgardie in Western Australia's Eastern Goldfields — confirming gold mineralisation extends to at least 332 metres depth, with highlights of 20 metres at 3.4 g/t gold from 93 metres and 18 metres at 2.9 g/t gold from 332 metres across 60 new drill holes (14,935 metres). With 78,000 metres completed since the existing 4.5 Moz Mineral Resource Estimate and ten rigs on site, an updated MRE targeted for August 2026 will upgrade Inferred to Indicated classification ahead of Pre-Feasibility Study advancement — positioning Bullabulling as one of WA's more credible large-scale open-pit development assets at $4,000+ gold.

headline: LOTUS RESTARTS KAYELEKERA URANIUM — Acid Plant Repaired; Malawi Mine Back Online; 2.4Mlb/yr Annual Capacity (ASX: LOT)
snippet: Lotus Resources Limited (ASX: LOT) restarted uranium production at the Kayelekera Mine in Malawi in early August 2026 following completion of acid plant remediation works that had temporarily suspended operations — returning to output at the mine that delivered 155,900 pounds of U3O8 in Q2 2026, its strongest quarterly result since restart. With an A$95 million capital raise in place to fund the operational reset and ramp-up toward steady-state production in Q4 2026, and an annual design capacity of approximately 2.4 million pounds of U3O8, Kayelekera's restart adds a new production source to a uranium market where spot prices hover near $86/lb and the term contract market has reached an 18-year high of $94/lb.

headline: WARATAH DRILLS 208.7m @ 1.17 g/t Au FROM 514m — NSW Gold System Spans 6km, Just 20% Tested; $30M Cash (ASX: WTM)
snippet: Waratah Minerals Ltd. (ASX: WTM) presented at Diggers & Dealers 2026 in Kalgoorlie on August 4-5 with a district-scale case for its gold project in western New South Wales, backed by a drill result of 208.7 metres at 1.17 g/t gold from 514 metres at the Spur Project — including 89 metres at 1.96 g/t gold from 614 metres. Management highlighted that only approximately 20% of the identified target area has been tested, the system already stretches more than 6 kilometres with a potential vertical extent exceeding 1 kilometre, and the company's large cash position supports a multi-year exploration campaign without dilution — making Waratah one of the better-funded early-stage gold exploration stories currently active in eastern Australia.

headline: GOLDSILVER: IRAN DEAL HOPE LIFTS GOLD — But The Fed Is The Only Driver That Matters Before Friday's Jobs Report
snippet: GoldSilver.com published analysis arguing that gold's Wednesday recovery toward $4,095 on Qatar's Strait of Hormuz proposal is structurally shallow — because the Iran de-escalation only removes one variable in the oil-inflation-rate-hike-dollar-gold chain, while the underlying driver of the metal's 27% drawdown from January's $5,598 record has been the Federal Reserve's pivot to a hawkish stance that 9 of 13 voting members endorsed at July's meeting. The piece frames Friday's July Non-Farm Payrolls as the binary that actually moves the needle: a sub-100,000 print severs the September hike thesis and opens a squeeze toward $4,150+, while 150,000+ jobs validates the hawks and extends the consolidation range — with every TSX-V and ASX junior gold NPV calculation hanging on which scenario unfolds.
